workload: Frozen DevProjex working tree, including pending regression/probe/report files. Same physical target for both versions; default GUI selection, compression/redaction disabled.
boundary: SelectionSyncCoordinator default snapshot, inventory projection, selection publication, and MetricsPipeline through background publication. Excludes window construction, profile persistence, animation gates, and first paint.
methodology: Two independent processes per version, 31 consecutive loads each. Per-process Run 0 reported separately; pooled median of all 60 Run 1..30 observations. Filesystem cache was not purged. Harness uses historical InvalidateCaches for baseline and RefreshDiscoveryCaches for comparison.
